result.title: Aerial Content-Aware Sample-Adaptive Classifier for Urban Photogrammetric Point Cloud Segmentation
result.summary: Urban photogrammetric point clouds are commonly processed as local 3D patches, limiting the context available for distinguishing geometrically similar categories. Orthographic projection of the same data yields a co-registered digital orthophoto map (DOM)/RGB-D representation that supports efficient large-context modeling but compresses vertical geometry. Existing projection--point methods mainly fuse these two representations at the feature level while retaining a classifier shared across all samples. We present the Aerial Content-Aware Sample-Adaptive Classifier (ACASAC), which complements feature fusion with decision-level adaptation. A point-aligned aerial region bridges the full aerial crop and local 3D patch. ACASAC models scene-to-local variation within the projection and the representation discrepancy between aligned 2D and 3D supports, then transfers both relations to refine the local point class representation. The refined representation, scene-level aerial context, and fixed fused-head prior jointly form a classifier for the current sample. ACASAC improves the fixed dual-representation head by 2.1 and 2.7 mIoU points on SensatUrban and UrbanBIS, respectively, and by 2.1--2.3 points across four tested encoder combinations.

AI.brief_summary: 该文面向城市摄影测量点云分割，提出 ACASAC：在融合正射影像与局部 3D patch 特征之外，利用点对齐航拍区域建模场景到局部的变化及 2D/3D 表示差异，据此细化局部点类别表示，并为每个样本动态构成分类器。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按样本生成分类器并依据场景上下文与跨表示差异修正类别表示」可作为 LVR 中读出层如何随证据与上下文自适应使用的线索，但论文不涉及 latent 推理或 VLM 生成，迁移可能需较多核查。
